title: Functional bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; all are oversized
text:
Functional bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; all are oversized. This is a functional plastic bag organizer that comes in four separate compartments with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. It also comes with 16 plastic nubs to put on the corners on the underside to keep it from slipping around. Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. The nubs keep these from slipping around on the counter or in a drawer. However, the beauty of this design is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

I love the way this keeps all my plastic bags in order. However, another negative besides the fact that it cannot be hung is that all the holders are oversized compared to other organizers I tried. In addition, some of the entry holes have a few rough spots that could scratch one's hands.

Overall, this is a decent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I do wish it had a frame for at least three or all the compartments so that it could be hung. I also wish they were not so oversized (on the wide side). The rough spots can be lightly sanded down (even with a paper nail file), so that is not much of an issue to me.

The current price of $28.99 is competitively priced for this. However, I personally feel this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] is better if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. I tried all of these and the style is based on what one desires.

product_metadata.title: HOMBURY Bamboo Wrap Dispenser, aluminum foil organization and storage with Slide Cutter for kitchen foil and wrap with Wall Mount, Suitable for Plastic, Foil, Wax, Parchment Wraps (3 Slots)
features: 3 in 1 CLING FILM STORAGE DISPENSER: This foil and plastic wrap dispenser with cutter is perfectly designed to help you organize different wrap papers. The ideal way to store and cut your aluminum foil dispenser, plastic wrap, or wax paper. Measurements 13.8 x 8.1 x 3.0 inches

SUPERIOR BAMBOO MATERIAL: The aluminum foil dispenser with cutter is made of premium quality bamboo material with a machine polished and coated surface. The plastic wrap organizer is smooth, durable, and sturdy, equipped with anti-skid pads for stable performance.

BUILT-IN SLIDE CUTTER and REFILLING DOOR: Tired of cutting uneven wrap papers? Our foil and plastic wrap dispenser with cutter is equipped with a bidirectional and sliding knife in each slot, provides clean and smooth cutting of the paper wraps, and will NEVER hurt your delicate fingers. Equipped with a side door that provides convenient emptying and replacing of paper rolls.

NO MORE MESSY DRAWERS: This bamboo foil and plastic wrap organizer with slide cutter provides convenient storage of aluminum foil, wax paper, plastic paper, or saran wrap, keeping your kitchen drawers, cabinets, and countertops neat and organized. Compatible with most brands such as Saran Wrap, Glad Plastic, Reynolds Wrap, and Cut-Rite.

EASY TO OPERATE: Each slot has a larger middle opening, simply open the side opening, put the wrap organizer with cutter, and pull it to your desired length, then push the cutting slide knife to cut the food wrap neatly. The large opening at the center makes it easier for you to find the starting point of the wrap roll.
